current_example.problem:
Which of the following statements are true regarding the angles shown below?

I. $\angle AOB	\cong \angle COD$

II. $\angle COD \cong \angle BOC$

III. $m\angle BOC = m\angle DOE$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14162998/assets/7d0729a38dd775d0f049656b23755ace3b42d07a4040004e14942c789544c30b.png)
current_example.worked_solution:
From the diagram, we see that 

- $\angle AOB$ and $\angle COD$ are each marked with a single hash mark "$|$," while

- $\angle BOC$ and $\angle DOE$ are each marked with a double hash mark "$||.$"

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}∠AOB & ≅∠COD \\ ∠BOC & ≅∠DOE.\end{aligned}
$$

Consequently, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}m∠AOB & =m∠COD \\ m∠BOC & =m∠DOE.\end{aligned}
$$

So statements I and III are true, while statement II is false.
